# Varun Velhankar

> Head of Design at Property Vista. AI product design leader with 12+ years across PropTech, fintech, travel and government platforms. Based in Guelph, Ontario (Greater Toronto Area).

- Email: varunuxd@gmail.com

- [Oaken Digital — Varun Velhankar](https://www.varunvelhankar.com/work/oaken-digital.html): Case study: redesigning Oaken digital banking for customers over 60. Zero-touch account openings went from 20% to 83%.
- [Deposit Broker Portal — Varun Velhankar](https://www.varunvelhankar.com/work/deposit-broker-portal.html): Case study: a net-new broker portal that cut application turnaround from eight weeks to ten minutes.
- [Reverse Mortgage and Customer Journey Analytics — Varun Velhankar](https://www.varunvelhankar.com/work/reverse-mortgage-and-customer-journey.html): Two decks: launching the Home Trust reverse mortgage, and building one reliable view of the Oaken customer.
